shots.worn_notes: The double-breasted blazer is buttoned and seen from the back; the collar of the knit polo shows just above the blazer collar. The trousers are below the frame.
shots.scene_prompt: Cinematic film still in a modernist Milanese atrium. A tall man is seen from behind, framed from the waist up in the centre of the frame, standing still at the rail of an inner courtyard of warm walnut balconies and floating wooden staircases that rise out of focus around and above him. His head is turned a few degrees, so only the edge of his short grey beard and one ear show; swept-back silver-grey hair. Warm tungsten light from hidden lamps along the balconies, deep amber shadows, a faint haze in the air. The back of the blazer, its collar and the polo collar above it are the sharpest thing in the frame; the architecture melts into a soft amber blur. Shot on a 50mm lens at f/1.8 on Kodak Vision3 500T, slight halation, fine grain, muted warm grade.

Blue-hour photograph of Milan's Torre Velasca, the 1950s brutalist tower with its wider top section carried on diagonal concrete struts, seen from street level through the bare branches of winter plane trees. Thin fog softens the upper floors; a handful of windows glow warm. Deep blue sky fading to near black at the top, a band of orange street-light glow along the bottom edge. Vertical composition with the tower slightly off-centre and a lot of dark sky. Shot on a 50mm lens on Kodak Vision3 500T film, halation around the lit windows, fine grain, slightly underexposed. The street is empty: no people, no cars.

shots.worn_notes: Five polos folded and stacked, from the bottom up: black, charcoal, grey, taupe, off-white. Each is folded so its collar faces the camera; the stack is slightly uneven, as if folded by hand.
shots.scene_prompt: Still life on a dark oak shelf in an old Milanese tailoring room. A hand-folded stack of cashmere knit polos sits in the left two thirds of the frame, the collars facing the lens. A single warm lamp out of frame on the left rakes across the knit so every rib reads; behind, deep brown shadow and out-of-focus bolts of cloth on shelves. Shot on a 50mm lens at f/2.8 on Kodak Vision3 250D, fine grain, muted warm grade, true blacks.

shots.worn_notes: The double-breasted blazer is worn open over the black knit polo; black cashmere trousers; black suede loafers without socks.
shots.scene_prompt: Golden hour on Lake Como. A man sits on the varnished mahogany rear deck of a classic wooden runabout moored at the stone landing of an old villa, one forearm resting on the boat's edge, the other hand on his knee, looking across the water and not at the camera. Low warm sun from the left, long shadows, the mountains on the far shore in blue haze, the water glittering softly. The boat carries no badges, emblems or lettering. He is seen full length and fills about half the frame height, with boat and lake around him. Shot on a 50mm lens on Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, warm natural grade, deep blacks in his dark clothes.

Still life at a classic Milanese bar at seven in the morning. One small white espresso cup on its saucer with a little spoon stands on a dark green marble counter with a worn brass edge; a thin curl of steam rises. A low shaft of sunlight from the street door rakes across the marble and catches the crema. Behind, warm brown darkness with out-of-focus amber glass shapes and a polished wooden back bar. Shot on a 50mm lens at f/2 on Kodak Vision3 250D, shallow focus, fine grain, muted warm grade.

shots.worn_notes: The double-breasted blazer is buttoned; the ivory polo shows only as a thin strip where the blazer front opens below the buttons, if at all; espresso tailored trousers below the hem.
shots.scene_prompt: Close crop at hip height, no face in the frame: a man stands in a dim wood-panelled tailoring room, his right hand hanging loosely beside the lower front of his double-breasted blazer, the thumb just brushing the pocket, a hint of motion blur on the fingers. The frame shows the blazer's lower front with its pocket and one button, the hand, and the top of the trousers below the hem. A single warm window light from the left rakes across the cashmere knit so its texture reads; everything else falls into brown shadow. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/2.8 on Kodak Portra 400, fine grain, muted warm grade.

Looking straight up into the glass and iron dome of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan at first light. The octagonal cupola and its radiating iron ribs form a graphic pattern, pale cold dawn sky through the glass, the warm lamps along the cornices still lit, the painted lunettes in soft shadow. Only the dome and the upper arches are in frame: no shopfronts, no people. Shot on a 24mm lens on Kodak Portra 800, fine grain, slight softness towards the corners, a quiet cool-and-warm contrast.

shots.worn_notes: He wears the black cashmere lounge set: the knitted top and the matching drawstring trousers.
shots.scene_prompt: Night in a Milanese apartment high above the city. A man sits sideways in a low 1950s walnut armchair by a tall window, one leg crossed over the other, a small espresso cup in his hand, looking out at the city. Through the glass, out of focus, the lit silhouette of the Torre Velasca and scattered city lights in a deep blue night. The only light in the room is a small brass table lamp behind him, warm and low, leaving most of the room in shadow. Framed from the knees up, slightly from the side. Shot on a 35mm lens at f/1.8 on Kodak Vision3 500T, halation around the lamp and the city lights, fine grain, muted warm grade.

shots.worn_notes: The knitted top is folded once and laid over the arm of the armchair; the matching drawstring trousers lie folded on the seat beneath it.
shots.scene_prompt: Macro still life in a quiet Milanese apartment in the morning. The beige cashmere lounge set lies over the arm and seat of a 1950s walnut armchair. Low sun through tall half-closed shutters lays stripes of warm light across the knit, so every rib and stitch is visible; the rest of the room sits in soft shadow. Shot on a 100mm macro lens at f/4 on Kodak Portra 160, shallow depth of field, fine grain, gentle warm grade.

Looking straight down the elliptical stairwell of a 1950s Milanese palazzo: a spiral of pale marble steps with a slim dark walnut handrail coils down five floors to a black-and-white terrazzo landing at the bottom. Soft daylight from a skylight above, so the lower floors darken gradually. Empty. Black-and-white photograph on Ilford HP5 film with a 28mm lens, rich greys, deep blacks, fine grain.
